messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: mixture model in manual
parts:
Hi, I'm looking at the mixture model in the manual (p. 115 of the 2.12.0 manual). I see two potential problems:
1. Should we do orderded mu[K]; so that we solve the alising problem?
2. I'm worried about the cauchy(0,2.5); prior on sigma. I think that it may be necessary to exclude sigma from 0, for example using a lognormal prior. If any sigma can be near 0, this will cause the likelihood to blow up and it will give us a degenerate posterior.
A

parts:
I'll change the model in the manual:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/2122#issuecomment-264926925

But what we really need is more of a case study illustrating
the problems and possible solutions concretely with data. We
can load up a model and also plot how the likelihood goes to infinity
as variance shrinks.

- Bob
